[[File:Craftyvestara.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Vestara Khai's face adorned with Vor'shandi markings]]
'''Vor'shandi''' markings were painted on the members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The markings were made with the brown nectar of the [[S'rai plant]]. In [[41 ABY]], [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] had vor'shandi markings painted on her arms, and markings of the [[dalsa flower]] painted on her face.

Vor'shandi markings were not permanent; they were easily smeared and came off completely with [[Water/Legends|water]].
